name: Aisino Co.Ltd.
summary: Aisino Co.Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in digital finance and taxation, smart, and cybersecurity businesses in China and internationally. The company offers Golden Tax Disk, an equipment for tax control of the VAT invoice system; Tax UKey, a portable intelligent tax control device; VAT invoice invoicing software; and smart taxation products, such as fast ticketing, smart electronic tax bureau, smart tax big data analysis platform, and blockchain vehicle purchase tax management system.
